title: CoGeo-GS: Concept-Driven and Geometry-Aware Multi-Object Removal in 3D Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2608.26656v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-object removal in 3D scenes is challenging due to severe occlusions, semantic entanglement, and the difficulty of maintaining geometric and multi-view consistency. Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods perform well for single-object editing but scale poorly to multi-object scenarios, often requiring repetitive optimization and yielding unstable geometry in removed regions. We propose CoGeo-GS, a concept-driven framework for controllable multi-object removal in 3D scenes. CoGeo-GS assigns concept-aware semantic tags to Gaussians, enabling flexible object selection and reducing interference between foreground objects and background structures within a single optimization stage. To recover plausible geometry, we introduce a geometry-aware completion pipeline that combines monocular depth priors with diffusion-based refinement and boundary-aligned blending. translated_title: CoGeo-GS：概念驱动与几何感知的三维场景多物体移除
translated_abstract: 三维场景中的多物体移除因严重遮挡、语义纠缠以及难以保持几何和多视角一致性而充满挑战。现有的三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）方法在单物体编辑中表现良好，但在多物体场景中扩展性差，通常需要重复优化，并在移除区域产生不稳定的几何结构。我们提出CoGeo-GS，一个用于三维场景中可控多物体移除的概念驱动框架。CoGeo-GS为高斯体分配概念感知的语义标签，实现灵活的对象选择，并在单次优化阶段减少前景对象与背景结构之间的干扰。为恢复合理的几何结构，我们引入了一个几何感知的补全流程，该流程结合单目深度先验、基于扩散的细化以及边界对齐混合。几何正则化的细化策略进一步稳定了重建。
tldr: 本文提出CoGeo-GS，通过概念感知语义标签和几何感知补全流程，在单次优化中实现三维场景多物体移除，同时保证几何与多视角一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CoGeo-GS, which enables multi-object removal in 3D scenes within a single optimization stage by using concept-aware semantic tags and a geometry-aware completion pipeline, ensuring geometric and multi-view consistency.
